newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi Hollandi Bank nine-mth net up 15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Hollandi Bank nine-mth net up 15 pct.

text.p: Saudi Hollandi Bank said net profit rose 15.2 percent in the first nine months of 1996 to 117.3 million riyals ($31.3 million) from 101.8 million riyals in the same period last year.
A bank statement said customer deposits grew 13 percent to 9.63 billion riyals from 8.52 billion riyals.
Shareholders' equity increased to 1.21 billion riyals at end-September 1996 from 1.09 billion riyals at end-September 1995. Assets rose to 15.87 billion riyals from 13.61 billion.
Traded in the Saudi stock market, the bank is 40 percent owned by the Dutch ABN-Amro Bank. The rest is held by Saudi investors.
